scientific_question: Can exact reported-ray overlap and epipolar residual transport repair every remaining v137 observation-only failure while preserving the same 2A+2A^T online shell?

advisor_alignment.direction: Build a virtual reaction-flow CFD data set first, then migrate once to a new laboratory experimental data set.
advisor_alignment.camera_stress: Support active sets of 5, 7, 9 and 12 cameras under add/drop, order, noise, extrinsic and intrinsic perturbations.
advisor_alignment.future_real_data: Future laboratory displacement images, calibration and repeated-measurement noise remain outside this post-open capacity diagnostic.

prior_result.interpretation: v137 used the same normalized detector pixel across cameras. It did not use the actual three-dimensional correspondence of reported camera rays. v138 changes only that physical approximation.

data_contract.role: post-open fit-only ray-overlap representation capacity diagnostic
data_contract.factorized_conditions: The frozen v128 roster of 37 clean, observation-noise, pose, intrinsic and combined conditions.

representation_contract.parent_basis: Exactly the complete v137 signed-phase cross-camera basis, retained as the first 48 directions per active camera.
representation_contract.visible_inputs: The active-camera zero-start CGLS K1 detector residual, predicted correction dual and each active camera's 18-value reported geometry token.
representation_contract.base_focal_length: Use the known reported scenario base focal length. The per-camera current focal length remains pose-token entry 10.
representation_contract.target_ray_domain: Clip every reported target pixel ray to the closed normalized reconstruction cube [-1,1]^3.
representation_contract.depth_anchors: Use exactly the three Gauss-Legendre nodes -sqrt(3/5), 0 and +sqrt(3/5) on each clipped segment, with normalized weights 5/18, 8/18 and 5/18.
representation_contract.peer_reprojection: Project each target-ray anchor through every other active camera using its reported center, optical frame, source distance, focal length, detector scale and principal point.
representation_contract.peer_sampling: Bilinearly sample each peer's signed residual after lifting its two components with that peer pixel's exact local ray basis. Samples outside the peer detector or behind a pinhole camera are excluded.
representation_contract.symmetric_aggregation: Average over valid peer-anchor contributions using only the frozen quadrature weights. Exclude self. If no contribution is valid, return zero. This is symmetric in the active peer set.
representation_contract.target_projection: Project the aggregated world vector onto the exact local transverse basis of the target pixel ray.
representation_contract.phase: For each target camera/component use tanh(aligned_residual/RMS); RMS at most 1e-30 maps to zero.
representation_contract.new_directions: Multiply each v133 per-camera/component LL/LH/HL/HH direction by the ray-overlap phase map.
representation_contract.direction_order: All v137 parent directions, then all ray-overlap phase-modulated v133 directions.
representation_contract.nested_basis_counts: The full basis has 56 directions per camera: 280, 392, 504 and 672 for 5, 7, 9 and 12 cameras.
representation_contract.strict_containment: The first 48 directions per camera are exactly v137; zero new coefficients reproduce every v137 candidate.
representation_contract.camera_permutation_equivariance: Peer aggregation is shared and symmetric. Camera permutation may alter floating summation order only within 3e-15 in mechanical tests.
representation_contract.boundary_and_tie_break: Detector coordinates tolerate 2e-12 before clipping; bilinear floor/ceil uses the lower integer first; zero-valid peers map to zero.
representation_contract.deployment_boundary: Ray-overlap phase generation is deployment-visible. Truth-aware coefficients and candidate selection are capacity-only and not deployable estimators.

staged_evaluation.cheap_control_scope: Run deployment-visible per-camera/component joint ridge LS over all 28 directions on all 3700 cells.
staged_evaluation.parent_retention: Retain independently validated v137 candidates for the 3351 already-passing cells.
staged_evaluation.oracle_scope: Run the seven-candidate truth-aware roster only on the frozen 349 v137 failure indices.
staged_evaluation.stratified_readout: Report remaining failures by camera count, trajectory and clean/noise/pose/intrinsic/combined factor.
staged_evaluation.scientific_boundary: The selected result is a truth-aware nested-span capacity upper bound, not a deployable coefficient predictor.

objective_roster.finite_weight_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher field-lift error plus projection_weight times relative squared teacher projected-lift error.
objective_roster.projection_only_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher projected-lift error with zero field weight.
objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of regularized normal equations
objective_roster.independent_solver: float64 symmetric eigendecomposition of the same equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize coefficients to unit RMS and orient toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.selector: Prefer all-four-metric feasibility by minimum worst ratio, then observation ratio and roster order; otherwise prefer physical feasibility and minimum observation; otherwise physical minimax.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets, metrics and selector use already-opened fit truth only to measure capacity.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible ray-overlap residual joint ridge LS
cheap_control.definition: For each camera/component fit its 28 detector-space directions to the visible K1 residual with a fixed ridge, concatenate, normalize to unit RMS and use the unchanged observable line search.

accuracy_gate.grouping: Each complete trajectory separately over all 740 cells.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact A_g^T lift and one exact A_g projection
call_accounting.ray_overlap_generation_cost: Three fixed depth anchors, cross-camera reprojection, bilinear sampling, world-frame aggregation and target-frame projection; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.cheap_control_coefficient_cost: Detector-space 28x28 group solves only; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: Truth-aware batched lifts, seven solves and scoring are excluded from deployment cost claims.

decision_rule.cheap_control_pass_action: If the cheap control passes all cells and trajectories, attribute the result to the deterministic control.
decision_rule.oracle_pass_action: Only 3700/3700 plus all five trajectory tails, while the cheap control fails, authorizes a separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only coefficient predictor under complete-trajectory LOTO.
decision_rule.oracle_fail_action: Close this exact GL3 ray-overlap phase representation. Do not enlarge CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet; diagnose the remaining physical failure strata.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Failure does not prove all continuous epipolar representations impossible; success does not prove prediction, arbitrary camera-set generalization, speed, external generalization or real-BOST validity.
